description: Implementation of the RenderEngineThreaded class managing a threaded rendering engine, including thread management, scheduling, and rendering tasks.

classes.name: RenderEngineThreaded
classes.description: A class managing a threaded rendering engine, handling thread lifecycle, task scheduling, and rendering operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new RenderEngineThreaded instance.

methods.name: setSchedFifo
methods.description: Sets the thread scheduling policy to SCHED_FIFO or SCHED_OTHER.

methods.name: waitUntilInitialized
methods.description: Blocks until the rendering engine thread is initialized.

methods.name: primeCache
methods.description: Asynchronously primes the rendering cache.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the state of the rendering engine into a string.

methods.name: genTextures
methods.description: Generates textures in the rendering engine.

methods.name: deleteTextures
methods.description: Deletes textures in the rendering engine.

methods.name: mapExternalTextureBuffer
methods.description: Maps an external texture buffer for rendering.

methods.name: unmapExternalTextureBuffer
methods.description: Unmaps an external texture buffer.

methods.name: getMaxTextureSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum texture size supported.

methods.name: getMaxViewportDims
methods.description: Returns the maximum viewport dimensions.

methods.name: supportsProtectedContent
methods.description: Checks if protected content is supported.

methods.name: cleanupPostRender
methods.description: Performs cleanup after rendering.

methods.name: canSkipPostRenderCleanup
methods.description: Determines if post-render cleanup can be skipped.

methods.name: drawLayers
methods.description: Draws layers with specified display and buffer parameters.

methods.name: cleanFramebufferCache
methods.description: Cleans the framebuffer cache.

methods.name: getContextPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the context priority.

methods.name: supportsBackgroundBlur
methods.description: Checks if background blur is supported.

methods.name: onActiveDisplaySizeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the active display size.

methods.name: getRenderEngineTid
methods.description: Gets the thread ID of the render engine.

methods.name: setEnableTracing
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing.
